source_scope.use: literary form, scene, addressee, speech, refrain, command-performance, lament, tour, register, and closure evidence only

read: Gen/Exod/Lev M7 artifacts as read-only depth bar

summary.principle: Prefer complete literary actions, but expose a child when a fresh word-event, addressee, scene, form, temporal register, or formal colophon creates a genuine retrieval seam; every child retains its larger parent for hydration.

global_guards: Candidate literary evidence only; no reviewed-gold, route, graph, retrieval, theology, canon, authorship, chronology, identity, ethics, fulfillment, temple, land, ritual, or preferred-reading authority.
Chapter numbers and headings never decide a seam; cross-chapter continuity is retained when speech, action, vision movement, or register function continues.
No agreement is forced. CHALLENGE and INSUFFICIENT findings require author response, peer crosscheck, boss ruling, and an append-only appeal if disagreement survives.
No M1-M6 map, comparison synthesis, or T417 layer was used.

reviews.deciding_seam: Third-person double-dated superscription closes at 1:3; first-person 'I looked' opens the throne vision at 1:4.
reviews.counterevidence: Ezek.1.1-3 is a double-dated third-person superscription before the first-person vision begins with 'I looked' at 1:4; keeping it inside the vision hides a formal threshold.

reviews.deciding_seam: stand/hear commands; scroll command-performance.
reviews.counterevidence: A possible cut at 2:8 would isolate the scroll command, but it would detach the commanded ingestion from the commission speech that motivates it.

reviews.deciding_seam: sending imperatives; lifting; Tel Abib arrival.
reviews.counterevidence: A cut after 3:11 would separate the sending charge from the narrated transport and seven-day arrival that performs the commission.

reviews.deciding_seam: The watchman charge closes at 3:21; renewed hand, relocation to the plain, and a new speech-control scene open at 3:22.
reviews.counterevidence: The watchman warning and the constrained-speech scene share the commission theme, so any split at 3:22 must hydrate both children inside 3:16-27.

reviews.deciding_seam: tablet, posture and ration commands form one siege complex.
reviews.counterevidence: The tile siege, prostration-days, and ration commands could become three signs at 4:4 and 4:9, yet their cumulative performance depicts one Jerusalem siege complex.

reviews.deciding_seam: hair division followed by Jerusalem application.
reviews.counterevidence: The interpretation begins at 5:5, but detaching it would leave the weighed hair actions without their explicit Jerusalem application.

reviews.deciding_seam: fresh word-event; mountain address; desolation refrain.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 6:8 turns toward remnant memory, but the same mountain addressee and repeated recognition formula continue through 6:14.

reviews.deciding_seam: fresh word-event; repeated end/day language; estate close.
reviews.counterevidence: Verses 7:10 and 7:23 open internal escalations, but the recurring end/day language and collapse of every social estate bind the oracle.

reviews.deciding_seam: transport; repeated see-greater stations; judgment close.
reviews.counterevidence: The repeated 'have you seen' stations permit smaller tour children, yet all remain within the dated transport scene and its closing judgment at 8:18.

reviews.deciding_seam: summons; marking/striking; completion report.
reviews.counterevidence: The intercession at 9:8-10 could be isolated, but the execution command reaches narrative closure only when the linen-clothed agent reports completion in 9:11.

reviews.deciding_seam: coals action; chariot recognition; glory to east gate.
reviews.counterevidence: The descriptive reprise at 10:8 could follow a seam after the coal action, but coals, cherubim, wheels, and the moving glory form one continuous visionary station.

reviews.deciding_seam: relocation; leader oracle; narrated death and cry.
reviews.counterevidence: Pelatiah's death and the prophet's cry in 11:13 are a reaction coda; cutting them off would sever narrated consequence from the east-gate oracle.

reviews.deciding_seam: The heart/restoration oracle closes at 11:21; cherubim and glory move in 11:22 before transport back and report in 11:24-25.
reviews.counterevidence: The promise and the glory-departure remain one macro-scene, so children at 11:14-21 and 11:22-25 require mandatory 8:1-11:25 vision hydration.

reviews.deciding_seam: baggage/wall commands; audience question; explanation.
reviews.counterevidence: The enactment at 12:7 and audience question at 12:9 invite subunits, but command, performance, question, and interpretation form the complete baggage sign.

reviews.deciding_seam: fresh command; fearful eating; direct interpretation.
reviews.counterevidence: The speech to the people begins at 12:19, yet it is the direct explanation of the trembling meal commanded in 12:18.

reviews.deciding_seam: two word-events answer one timing controversy.
reviews.counterevidence: A fresh word-event at 12:26 could separate the second objection, but both sayings answer the same claim that prophetic fulfillment is delayed.

reviews.deciding_seam: A renewed 'Son of man, set your face against the daughters' addressee/form reset occurs at 13:17.
reviews.counterevidence: Both halves indict unauthorized prophetic speech and promise deliverance, so the gendered addressee reset at 13:17 should not erase the paired collection parent.

reviews.deciding_seam: elders sit; inquiry diagnosis; inquirer/prophet close.
reviews.counterevidence: The direct answer begins at 14:4 and a second case at 14:7, but the seated elders, heart-idol diagnosis, and inquirer-prophet close enclose one disputation.

reviews.deciding_seam: four repeated judgments; surviving-family consolation.
reviews.counterevidence: Each judgment in 14:13-20 can stand as a repeated case, but the fourfold Noah-Daniel-Job pattern needs the survivor coda in 14:21-23 for its full argument.

reviews.deciding_seam: sustained vine question; explicit Jerusalem application.
reviews.counterevidence: The Jerusalem application turns explicit at 15:6, but separating it would turn the vine questions into an uninterpreted image fragment.

reviews.deciding_seam: ancestry; abandonment; rescue; adornment climax.
reviews.counterevidence: The life-command at 16:6 and adornment at 16:10 create internal stages, but abandonment, rescue, maturation, and royal beauty complete one positive movement before 16:15.

reviews.deciding_seam: trust-in-beauty turn; misuse catalogue; therefore sentence.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 16:35 begins the announced sentence, yet it answers the accumulated prostitution accusation and reaches its calming close at 16:43.

reviews.literary_form: comparative city allegory with covenant coda
reviews.deciding_seam: The comparison/sentence reaches 16:58; a fresh covenant-remembrance turn begins at 16:59.
reviews.counterevidence: The covenant turn at 16:59 is a sharp coda seam, while the mother-sister comparison and shame vocabulary also carry across it; local English literary evidence alone does not settle standalone retrieval.

reviews.deciding_seam: riddle; explanation; cedar conclusion remain joined.
reviews.counterevidence: The explanation starts at 17:11 and the cedar promise at 17:22, but riddle, interpretation, and concluding tree reversal are deliberately interlocked.

reviews.deciding_seam: proverb; three-generation cases; objections; appeal.
reviews.counterevidence: The three-generation cases and the objection at 18:25 could be divided, but proverb rebuttal, case reasoning, fairness challenge, and final appeal constitute one sustained disputation.

reviews.deciding_seam: lament command; linked royal images; lament refrain.
reviews.counterevidence: The lioness and vine images turn at 19:10, yet the explicit lament frame at 19:1 and 19:14 makes their pairing the governing form.

reviews.deciding_seam: dated inquiry; Egypt/wilderness generations; nation-aim close.
reviews.counterevidence: The rehearsal changes epochs at 20:10 and 20:27, but the elders' inquiry and repeated rebellion pattern carry one argument through the rejected aspiration in 20:32.

reviews.deciding_seam: as-I-live turn; bond judgment; land/shame recognition.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 20:40 begins a worship/restoration elaboration, but mighty-hand gathering, wilderness judgment, acceptance, and remembered ways make one answer to 20:32.

reviews.deciding_seam: forest-fire speech; parable complaint; sword clarification.
reviews.counterevidence: WEB 20:45-49 and 21:1-5 divide the image from its interpretation by versification, while the forest/fire, sword, and public sigh remain one linked oracle sequence through 21:7.

reviews.deciding_seam: fresh word-event; sword refrain; thigh-striking anguish.
reviews.counterevidence: The doubled sword cries and gesture directions contain strophic pauses, but sharpened sword, clapped hands, and wrath-rest refrain close one poem at 21:17.

reviews.literary_form: road-divination report with royal and Ammon oracles
reviews.deciding_seam: Road/divination report ends at 21:23; royal sentence begins at 21:24; explicit Ammon addressee begins at 21:28.
reviews.counterevidence: The road sign, royal sentence, and Ammon oracle all remain under the two-way sword problem, so split children must retain 21:18-32 as their hydrating parent.

reviews.deciding_seam: judge command; cumulative charges; dispersal close.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 22:6 moves from city address to named ruling classes and 22:13 to sentence, but the bloody-city summons governs accusation and judgment through 22:16.

reviews.deciding_seam: fresh word-event; dross naming; furnace application.
reviews.counterevidence: The gathering threat begins at 22:19, yet it is the explicit interpretation and completion of the dross metaphor introduced in 22:18.

reviews.deciding_seam: prophets/priests/princes/people; failed intercessor close.
reviews.counterevidence: The catalogue moves through prophets, priests, princes, and people, but the failed search for one gap-stander and final sentence complete its social-estate design.

reviews.deciding_seam: A renewed judicial commission, 'Will you judge Oholah and Oholibah?', opens at 23:36 after the paired narrative/sentence through 23:35.
reviews.counterevidence: The judicial recommission at 23:36 strongly supports a child seam, but both portions continue the paired-sisters comparison; without an independent adjudicator the larger allegory remains defensible.

reviews.deciding_seam: exact date; pot commands; blood/corrosion explanation.
reviews.counterevidence: The interpretation becomes direct at 24:6 and intensifies at 24:11, but pot image, failed cleansing, and irrevocable sentence are one dated parable movement.

reviews.deciding_seam: command; death/performance; audience answer; forecast.
reviews.counterevidence: The wife's death sign reaches audience explanation at 24:24, while 24:25-27 projects the fugitive and reopened mouth; the latter completes the sign's announced communicative hinge.

reviews.deciding_seam: Ammon address; hostile exclamation; recognition close.
reviews.counterevidence: Ammon's accusation and sentence turn at 25:6, but the named addressee and recognition close make 25:1-7 the smallest complete nation oracle.

reviews.deciding_seam: new addressee and accusation-sentence formula.
reviews.counterevidence: The Ammon reference in 25:10 overlaps the preceding target, yet the because-therefore frame beginning with Moab and Seir closes at 25:11.

reviews.deciding_seam: new because-therefore Edom formula.
reviews.counterevidence: The instrument 'by the hand of my people Israel' could be isolated as a coda, but it belongs to Edom's because-therefore vengeance oracle.

reviews.deciding_seam: new vengeance accusation; collection close.
reviews.counterevidence: The Cherethite and coast details elaborate the sentence; no new speech, target, or form interrupts the Philistine oracle before 25:17.

reviews.deciding_seam: date/addressee; siege/descent tableau; no-more close.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 26:7 names the agent and 26:15 shifts to coastland reaction, but both answer Tyre's boast and culminate in the city's disappearance at 26:21.

reviews.deciding_seam: lament command; construction/trade; wreck/mourning arc.
reviews.counterevidence: Cargo inventory, wreck, and international mourning could be retrieved as movements, yet the ship metaphor and lament command frame the whole composition through 27:36.

reviews.deciding_seam: prince address; pride/wisdom/wealth; mortality sentence.
reviews.counterevidence: The wisdom catalogue at 28:3-5 and invader sentence at 28:6-10 are argument and consequence within one address to the prince of Tyre.

reviews.deciding_seam: lament command; perfection/sanctuary/corruption; no-more close.
reviews.counterevidence: The Eden setting gives way to expulsion and trader judgment, but the lament command and repeated terror close keep 28:11-19 intact.

reviews.deciding_seam: The Sidon oracle and thorn relief close at 28:24; a new divine-speech formula and gathered-Israel subject begin at 28:25.
reviews.counterevidence: The secure-dwelling coda grows from relief from surrounding thorns, but 28:25 begins a new divine-speech formula and changes the addressee from Sidon to gathered Israel.

reviews.deciding_seam: date; monster capture; dispersal/low-kingdom explanation.
reviews.counterevidence: The crocodile image yields to land judgment and restoration in 29:8-16, but the dated Pharaoh/Egypt address and failed-confidence conclusion enclose the oracle.

reviews.deciding_seam: later date; Tyre labor; Egypt wages; mouth opening.
reviews.counterevidence: The horn and opened-mouth promise in 29:21 is a short coda, yet it is syntactically tied to the dated retrospective compensation oracle and is too thin alone.

reviews.deciding_seam: howl-for-day opening; allies/cities; recognition close.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 30:10 shifts from day lament to named agent and 30:13 to city catalogue, but wailing day, Egypt-wide execution, and recognition close unify 30:1-19.

reviews.deciding_seam: new date; broken/strengthened arms; scattering.
reviews.counterevidence: The broken-arm diagnosis at 30:21 and strengthened-arm outcome at 30:24 are the two halves of one dated body metaphor.

reviews.deciding_seam: greatness question; cedar/felling; Pharaoh descent.
reviews.counterevidence: The descent-to-Sheol movement begins at 31:15, but it supplies the fate that interprets the cedar comparison and its final Pharaoh application.

reviews.deciding_seam: lament command; capture/cosmic darkening; sword devastation.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 32:9 widens to nation reaction, yet monster capture, darkened cosmos, astonishment, sword, desolation, and explicit lament colophon form one ruler lament.

reviews.deciding_seam: new date/wail; Egypt and nations in one pit tableau.
reviews.counterevidence: Each named underworld nation could be a child catalogue entry, but the repeated 'there is' structure and Pharaoh frame require the whole descent sequence.

reviews.deciding_seam: The watchman analogy closes with accountability at 33:9; 'As for you' introduces the people's objection-response at 33:10.
reviews.counterevidence: The watchman analogy closes at 33:9; 33:10 starts a distinct objection-response about responsibility, even though both concern warning and response.

reviews.literary_form: fall-messenger report with two post-fall audience oracles
reviews.deciding_seam: Messenger and opened-mouth report close at 33:22; a word-event launches the land-claim oracle at 33:23; a new audience address opens at 33:30.
reviews.counterevidence: The arrival, land-claim oracle, and audience critique share the post-fall hinge, but fresh word-event and addressee changes at 33:23 and 33:30 mark three retrievable movements.

reviews.deciding_seam: self-feeding charge; therefore searching/gathering answer.
reviews.counterevidence: The shepherd indictment reverses into first-person rescue around 34:11, yet self-feeding versus divine shepherding is the designed contrast of a single oracle.

reviews.deciding_seam: Judgment between flock members resolves at 34:22; a distinct shepherd/covenant restoration promise begins at 34:23.
reviews.counterevidence: The flock judgment at 34:17-22 and shepherd/covenant restoration at 34:23-31 have different argumentative tasks, but sheep vocabulary and recognition closure also support one parent; adjudication is still needed.

reviews.deciding_seam: fresh word-event; Seir address; desolation reversal.
reviews.counterevidence: Repeated because-therefore turns could yield smaller charges, but Mount Seir remains the sole addressee and the rejoicing/desolation reversal closes at 35:15.

reviews.deciding_seam: new mountain address; enemy reproach answer; fruit/rebuilding.
reviews.counterevidence: Verse 36:8 turns from enemy rebuttal to direct mountain promise, but the land addressee and reversal of devouring/reproach carry the counter-oracle to 36:15.

reviews.literary_form: defilement rationale and three-stage restoration oracle
reviews.deciding_seam: Defilement/exile rationale closes at 36:21; a direct restoration speech begins at 36:22; 'In the day that I cleanse you' begins the rebuilt-land result at 36:33.
reviews.counterevidence: The sequence is thematically cumulative, but word-event framing, the explicit 'not for your sake' address at 36:22, and the new temporal formula at 36:33 mark three independent argument movements.

reviews.deciding_seam: transport; two prophecies; body/breath stages; explicit answer.
reviews.counterevidence: The four commands to bones/breath could be atomized, but the guided vision, performance, animation, and explicit house-of-Israel explanation require 37:1-14 together.

reviews.deciding_seam: inscribed sticks; joining; audience question; unity explanation.
reviews.counterevidence: The stick inscriptions and joining action need the audience question and kingdom/sanctuary interpretation; neither half is complete without the other.

reviews.deciding_seam: Gog address; host/plan; earthquake/sword/elements response.
reviews.counterevidence: The planning speech at 38:10 and earthquake/judgment at 38:18 are internal movements, but one Gog address carries summons, invasion, and defeat to 38:23.

reviews.deciding_seam: Defeat and seven-month burial close at 39:16; a renewed 'Son of man' summons opens the carrion-feast oracle at 39:17.
reviews.counterevidence: The carrion-feast command at 39:17 is a genuine new address/form, while burial and feast jointly portray the aftermath of the same Gog defeat; the better retrieval seam remains contestable.

reviews.deciding_seam: glory transition; exile explanation; no-hiding/spirit close.
reviews.counterevidence: Captivity explanation, regathering, face, and Spirit language are a compact restoration coda to the Gog cycle; splitting any clause would create proof-text fragments.

reviews.deciding_seam: date/transport; measuring guide; see-hear-report command.
reviews.counterevidence: The four-verse date, transport, guide, and attention charge is a formal superscription; it must never surface without the 40:1-48:35 tour parent.

reviews.deciding_seam: wall-to-gate movement; one complete gate complex.
reviews.counterevidence: Wall measurement precedes the east-gate station in 40:5, but the wall establishes the station's approach and no completed function intervenes before 40:16.

reviews.deciding_seam: court/pavement; north-south gates; comparative distances.
reviews.counterevidence: North and south gate descriptions could be separate children at 40:20 and 40:24, yet outer-court pavement and inter-gate distances organize a single comparative survey.

reviews.deciding_seam: inner entry; south/east/north parallel complexes.
reviews.counterevidence: Each inner gate begins with guide movement at 40:28, 40:32, and 40:35, but repeated dimensions and eight-step access make the three-gate comparison the literary point.

reviews.deciding_seam: Sacrificial washing/tables close at 40:43; singer/priest rooms begin at 40:44 and conclude with inner-court/altar orientation at 40:47.
reviews.counterevidence: The slaughter tables end at 40:43 and priestly rooms begin at 40:44; combining them obscures two functional inventories even though both occupy the inner-gate/court station.

reviews.deciding_seam: continuous threshold movement across chapter seam.
reviews.counterevidence: The chapter boundary at 41:1 is not a seam: movement from porch through nave to the declared most-holy place is one continuous inward measurement.

reviews.deciding_seam: side stories; wall/foundation; doors/free space.
reviews.counterevidence: Stories, supports, widening, foundations, and north/south doors all describe the side-room structure; isolated measurement snippets would lose the three-dimensional unit.

reviews.deciding_seam: Rear-building and total dimensions close at 41:15; threshold, wall-decoration, table, and door inventory begins at 41:16.
reviews.counterevidence: The overall building measurements close at 41:15 before thresholds, wall decoration, table, and doors begin; the two inventories share location but not immediate function.

reviews.deciding_seam: north/south blocks; galleries; priestly-use explanation.
reviews.counterevidence: The north/south chamber blocks and their priestly-use explanation must remain together; a cut at 42:13 would detach function from surveyed space.

reviews.deciding_seam: inner-house completion; exit; four-direction boundary.
reviews.counterevidence: The repeated four-side measurements could be four list items, but the concluding holy/common separation gives the perimeter survey a single purpose.

reviews.deciding_seam: east approach; filling; dwelling/defilement/report speech.
reviews.counterevidence: The glory arrival could close at 43:5 or 43:9 before the reporting commission, but shame, disclosure, and 'law of the house' make the commission the vision climax's response.

reviews.deciding_seam: altar measures; when-finished turn; seven-day/eighth-day arc.
reviews.counterevidence: Altar dimensions end at 43:17 and consecration begins at 43:18, yet the seven-day rites explain how the measured altar enters its intended service.

reviews.deciding_seam: The shut east-gate/prince access rule closes at 44:3; north-gate relocation and renewed attention command begin at 44:4.
reviews.counterevidence: The east-gate/prince rule ends at 44:3; guide relocation, renewed attention charge, sanctuary-access indictment, and Levite reassignment begin a separate corrective unit at 44:4.

reviews.deciding_seam: but-the-priests reset; office rules and livelihood.
reviews.counterevidence: Clothing, marriage, instruction, inheritance, food, and first-fruit clauses are diverse, but the Zadokite-priest subject and near-service contrast govern the whole register.

reviews.deciding_seam: when-you-divide; contribution constituencies; anti-oppression close.
reviews.counterevidence: Priest, Levite, city, and prince portions are internally distributive, while the lot-division opening and anti-oppression close make one land-allocation unit.

reviews.deciding_seam: enough address; standard measures; communal dues.
reviews.counterevidence: Just measures and communal offerings could split at 45:13, but both regulate princely justice and the people's/prince's reciprocal cultic obligations.

reviews.literary_form: annual, weekly/monthly, voluntary, and daily cultic calendar register
reviews.deciding_seam: Annual purification and festivals close at 45:25; Sabbath/new-moon gate rules begin at 46:1; the daily morning offering begins at 46:13.
reviews.counterevidence: Annual purification/feasts, Sabbath-new-moon gate practice, and the daily offering each have distinct temporal frames; merging them hides three calendar forms despite their shared cultic domain.

reviews.deciding_seam: thus-says reset; sons/servants; anti-displacement close.
reviews.counterevidence: Son, servant, jubilee, and anti-displacement clauses form one compact inheritance case; none has enough independent framing to stand alone.

reviews.deciding_seam: guide relocation; priest and outer-court cooking places.
reviews.counterevidence: The priest kitchen and four outer-court kitchens could split at 46:21, but guide movement and repeated boiling-place explanation invite comparative retrieval as one station.

reviews.deciding_seam: house source; four depths; question; sea/fish/tree effects.
reviews.counterevidence: Depth measurements could form stages at 47:3-5 and ecological effects at 47:8, but guide movement, question, sea healing, fish, and trees complete one water-vision arc.

reviews.deciding_seam: equal inheritance; four borders; resident allotment coda.
reviews.counterevidence: The geographical borders end at 47:20 before resident-alien inheritance, yet the latter expressly states who participates in the just-defined allotment and is its legal coda.

reviews.deciding_seam: these-are-the-names; Dan-to-Judah sequence.
reviews.counterevidence: The repeated one-portion clauses can be atomized, but the 'names of the tribes' heading and uninterrupted Dan-to-Judah order define one northern list.

reviews.deciding_seam: sanctuary/priest/Levite/city/prince zones.
reviews.counterevidence: Priest, Levite, city, and prince zones admit internal children, yet every subsection locates a constituent within the same central contribution between Judah and Benjamin.

reviews.literary_form: southern allotment list and city-gate/name colophon
reviews.deciding_seam: The southern tribal allotment reaches its colophon at 48:29; 'These are the exits of the city' opens a new city-gate register at 48:30.
reviews.counterevidence: The southern tribal list closes formally at 48:29; 48:30 begins a new city-exit/gate register whose terminal city name supplies the book's close.
